verdict.rationale: ChatGPT's own app listing documents photo upload with interpretation, such as snapping or uploading a picture to transcribe handwriting or identify a landmark, so the core image-understanding capability exists. Evidence is a single thin marketing mention, though. It does not cover user-shared screenshots of work content or show how accurate the interpretation is. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of uploading and interpreting screenshots, in-depth first-party docs on image understanding, independent or hands-on corroboration of accuracy.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can share screenshots and photos and have the assistant accurately interpret what is in them

citations.quote: Photo upload—Snap or upload a picture to transcribe a handwritten recipe or get info about a landmark.
